stock.description: UBoT Holding Ltd., an investment holding firm, specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of back-end semiconductor transport media, alongside micro-electro-mechanical-system (MEMS) and sensor packaging solutions. Its core offerings include various handling equipment such as trays and related accessories, which serve as crucial containers for semiconductor components throughout their production and delivery cycles. The company also develops carrier tapes vital for protecting diverse semiconductor devices, including power discrete components, optoelectronics, integrated circuits (ICs), and sensors. Complementing these transport solutions, UBoT provides specialized packaging for MEMS and sensor technologies. The firm serves a diverse range of clients within the semiconductor industry, such as fabless-foundry companies, integrated device manufacturers (IDMs), IC assembly specialists, and packaging test enterprises. Established in 2005 and headquartered in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong, UBoT maintains a global footprint with operations in Hong Kong, mainland China, Southeast Asia, Taiwan, the United States, Europe, Korea, and Japan. It operates as a subsidiary of Sino Success Ventures Limited.
